name: Leaning back, one knee up
description: Sitting on the floor leaning back on the right hand. The left knee is raised with the left forearm resting on it; the right leg is bent along the floor. The head tips back.

name: One hand down, legs swept forward
description: Sitting with both legs bent and swept forward to one side. The torso leans slightly, supported by one straight arm on the floor; the other hand rests on the knee.

name: Leaning back on both hands, chest out
description: Sitting with the legs stretched forward, knees slightly bent. Both hands are on the floor behind the hips, arms straight, chest lifted.

name: Knees up, tipped to the left
description: Sitting with both knees bent up together and tipped over to the figure's left. Both hands are on the floor behind; the torso upright.

name: Legs out to one side, hand on hip
description: Sitting with both legs stretched out diagonally to one side, knees slightly bent. One hand is on the hip, the other arm straight down on the floor.

name: Reclining on both elbows
description: Half-lying on both forearms, the upper body raised and the legs stretched out straight in front together.

name: Knees up, hands behind the head
description: Sitting with both knees bent up and feet flat. Both hands are clasped behind the head with the elbows wide; the back straight.

name: Leaning right on an elbow
description: Sitting with the legs stretched forward together, the torso leaning to the right and propped on the right elbow. The left hand rests on the left hip.

name: Reaching for the ankle
description: Sitting with the legs bent and drawn in, leaning forward, one hand reaching to touch the ankle; the other hand on the floor behind.

name: Hands behind the head, chest arched
description: Sitting with the legs stretched forward and knees slightly bent. Both hands are behind the head, elbows wide, the chest lifted and back arched.

name: Leaning back, both legs raised
description: Sitting balanced on the hips, leaning back, with both legs raised together and the knees slightly bent. The hands rest on the floor behind for support.

name: One knee up, holding the ankle
description: Sitting with the right knee raised; the right hand holds the ankle. The left leg is bent along the floor, the left hand propped behind.

name: Contrapposto, hand on hip
description: Standing with weight on one leg, the other knee relaxed and slightly forward. One hand on the hip, the other arm hanging; the shoulders tilt opposite the hips.

name: Looking back over the shoulder
description: Standing turned three-quarters away, weight on one leg. The head turns to look back over the shoulder; the arms hang loosely.

name: Both hands on the hips
description: Standing with feet hip-width apart and weight even. Both hands are on the hips, elbows out to the sides; head straight.

name: Both arms straight up
description: Standing with feet apart. Both arms are stretched straight up above the head, palms forward.

name: One hand behind the head
description: Standing with weight on one leg, the other knee bent. One hand is behind the head with the elbow high; the other hand on the hip.

name: Hand at the neck and on the thigh
description: Standing with knees together and one knee bent. One hand touches the side of the neck; the other rests on the front of the thigh.

name: Arms back, chest out
description: Standing with feet apart. Both arms are held straight back and slightly out from the body, palms back, pushing the chest forward.

name: One foot kicked up behind
description: Standing on the left leg; the right knee bends to lift the foot up behind. One hand is behind the head, the other arm out for balance.

name: Feet wide, hands on the hips
description: Standing with the feet wide apart and the legs straight. Both hands are on the hips, elbows out; chest up.

name: One arm up, hip out
description: Standing with the hip pushed out to the side, weight on that leg. One arm is raised straight up; the other hand is on the hip.

name: Both hands at the nape
description: Standing with feet together. Both hands are clasped at the back of the neck, elbows forward.

name: Hair blown, hand at the head
description: Standing with weight on one leg. One hand is raised to the head as if holding blowing hair; the other hand on the hip.

name: On tiptoe, arms in a V
description: Standing on the toes with the heels raised. Both arms are stretched up and out in a wide V, fingers spread.

name: Kneeling upright, hands on thighs
description: Kneeling upright on both knees, thighs vertical, back straight. Both hands rest on the front of the thighs.

name: Kneeling upright, hands behind the head
description: Kneeling upright on both knees. Both hands are clasped behind the head with the elbows wide; the chest lifts.

name: One knee down, hand on the knee
description: Kneeling on the left knee with the right foot planted in front. The right hand rests on the raised knee; the left hand hangs.

name: Kneeling, leaning back
description: Kneeling upright with the torso leaning back from the knees, the head tipped back. The arms hang at the sides, hands near the heels.

name: Kneeling, arms straight up
description: Kneeling upright on both knees. Both arms are raised straight above the head, palms together.

name: Kneeling, hand in hair, hand on hip
description: Kneeling upright on both knees. One hand touches the hair behind the head; the other is on the hip.

name: One knee down, looking up
description: Kneeling on one knee with the other foot planted in front. One hand rests at the chin, the head tilted up as if looking at something above.

name: Kneeling, leaning on one hand
description: Kneeling with the body leaning to one side, supported on one hand on the floor. The other arm reaches up and out; the head follows it.

name: Kneeling, hands on the hips, arched
description: Kneeling upright on both knees, both hands on the hips with the elbows back, the back arched and chest lifted.

name: Kneeling, hips swung, one arm up
description: Kneeling with the hips swung to one side. One hand is on the thigh; the other arm is raised with the hand behind the head.

name: Sitting between the heels, hands on thighs
description: Sitting on the floor between the feet (knees together, feet out to the sides). Both hands rest on the thighs; back upright.

name: Sitting between the heels, hands down in front
description: Sitting between the feet with the knees together. Both arms reach straight down in front, palms on the floor beside the knees.

name: Sitting between the heels, hands behind the head
description: Sitting between the feet with the knees together. Both hands are clasped behind the head with the elbows wide.

name: Sitting between the heels, hands behind
description: Sitting between the feet with the knees together, leaning back slightly on both hands placed on the floor behind.

name: Side sit, legs to the right
description: Sitting with both legs folded to the figure's right. One hand rests on the thigh, the other on the floor at the side.

name: Side sit, hand on the cheek
description: Sitting with the legs folded to one side, propped on one hand on the floor. The other hand touches the cheek; head tilted.

name: Side sit, one arm reaching up
description: Sitting with the legs folded to one side, one hand on the floor. The other arm stretches up overhead; the head looks up toward it.

name: Sitting between the heels, hand at the neck
description: Sitting between the feet with the knees together. One hand touches the side of the neck; the other rests on the thigh.

name: On the back, arms overhead
description: Lying flat on the back, legs straight together. Both arms are stretched up over the head along the floor.

name: On the side, head propped
description: Lying on the side with the head propped on the lower hand, elbow on the floor. The legs are straight and stacked, the top hand on the hip.

name: On the front, feet up
description: Lying on the stomach propped on the forearms, hands together in front. Both knees bend so the feet point up behind.

name: On the back, one knee up
description: Lying on the back with one knee bent up and the foot flat. One arm is stretched out to the side; the other hand rests on the stomach.

name: On the side, waist curved
description: Lying on the side, the head resting on the lower arm. The top knee is bent forward over the lower leg, curving the waist.

name: On the back, legs straight up
description: Lying on the back with both legs raised straight up together toward the ceiling. The arms are on the floor out to the sides.

name: On the side, one arm overhead
description: Lying on the side with the lower arm stretched out over the head along the floor and the head resting on it. The legs are straight.

name: On the front, head on the arms
description: Lying on the stomach with the legs straight. The arms are folded under the head, the cheek resting on them.

name: On the back, chest arched
description: Lying on the back with both knees bent up. The arms are stretched out to the sides and up; the chest lifts in an arch.

name: Squatting, hands on the knees
description: Squatting low on the toes with the knees together in front. Both hands rest on the knees; the head looks up.

name: Squatting, one hand on the floor
description: Squatting low with the knees forward. One hand rests on the knee; the other is on the floor at the side for balance.

name: Squatting, chin in hands
description: Squatting low with the knees together. Both elbows rest on the knees and the chin rests in the hands.

name: Squatting, hand in the hair
description: Squatting low with the knees together. One hand touches the hair at the back of the head; the other rests on the knee.

name: Squatting on tiptoes, hands on the floor
description: Squatting on the balls of the feet with the knees together. Both hands are on the floor in front of the feet, arms straight.

name: Squatting, looking back
description: Squatting low, the torso turned to look back over the shoulder. One hand on the knee, the other on the floor behind.

name: Bent over, hands on the knees
description: Standing with the feet apart and knees slightly bent, bending forward from the hips. Both hands rest on the knees; the head looks forward.

name: Bent over, touching the shins
description: Standing with straight legs, folding forward from the hips. Both hands slide down to touch the shins; the head hangs down.

name: Bent forward, hands on thighs, hips back
description: Feet apart, knees slightly bent, the hips pushed back and the torso leaning forward. Both hands rest on the thighs above the knees.

name: Bent over, arms hanging
description: Standing with straight legs, folding forward from the hips with the back rounded. Both arms hang loosely toward the floor; the head hangs down.

name: Bent forward, one leg back
description: Standing on one leg and tipping the torso forward while the other leg lifts straight back, like an arabesque. The arms reach out to the sides.

name: Standing back bend
description: Standing with feet together and both hands on the hips, arching the upper back and tipping the head back.

name: Kneeling back bend, hands behind
description: Kneeling and leaning back, the hips sinking toward the heels, both hands flat on the floor behind the feet. The chest lifts and the head drops back.

name: Arched back, both arms up
description: Standing with feet apart, arching back with both arms raised up and back over the head, hands open.

name: Twisting, arms spread
description: Standing with feet apart, the upper body twisting to one side with both arms spread wide at shoulder height.

name: Kneeling, turning to look back
description: Kneeling and sitting back on the heels, the torso twisting to look back over the shoulder. One hand rests on the thigh, the other on the floor behind.

name: Sitting, upper body twisted
description: Sitting with the legs bent to one side, the upper body twisting the other way. Both hands are on the floor on the side the torso turns to.

name: S-curve, hip out
description: Standing in an S-curve: weight on the right leg, hip pushed out to that side, left knee bent in with the heel raised. Right hand on the right hip, left hand behind the head, head tilted toward the raised elbow.

name: Back arched, hands in the hair
description: Standing with feet together, back arched and chest lifted. Both hands raised behind the head, fingers in the hair, elbows pointing forward and out; head tipped slightly back.

name: From behind, hips out, looking back
description: Seen from behind: standing with hips pushed back and to the right, knees soft, left foot stepping out. Hands on the hips, torso twisted so the head turns back over the right shoulder.

name: Leaning forward, hands on knees
description: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, hips pushed back. The torso leans forward about 45° with a straight back, both hands resting on the knees, head up looking forward.

name: Knee hugged to chest
description: Standing on the left leg. The right knee is pulled high up to the chest and hugged with both arms; the back arches slightly and the head tilts back.

name: From behind, looking back
description: Seen from behind: standing with feet apart and weight on the left leg, hips tilted. Arms hang loosely; the head turns to look back over the left shoulder.

name: Standing split, holding the ankle
description: Standing on the left leg. The right leg is raised straight up beside the head and held at the ankle with the right hand; the left arm reaches out to the side for balance.

name: Running hands through the hair
description: Standing with weight on one leg, the other knee bent and heel lifted. Both hands are raised to the head, pushing the hair back, elbows high; the head tilts back and to one side.

name: Leg raised high to the side
description: Standing on the left leg. The right leg is lifted straight out to the side at shoulder height, held at the ankle with the right hand; the left arm curves over the head.

name: Forward fold, hands on the floor
description: Legs straight and apart, folding forward from the hips until both palms are flat on the floor in front of the feet. The head hangs down between the arms, hips high.

name: Hands on hips, knee turned in
description: Standing with the back slightly arched. Both hands on the hips with elbows out; the right knee turns inward across the left with the heel raised.

name: Side sit, leaning on one hand
description: Sitting on the floor with both legs folded to the left side. The torso leans and curves to the right, propped on the right hand placed behind; the left hand rests on the left knee.

name: Sitting on the heels, chest lifted
description: Kneeling and sitting back on the heels, knees together. The chest lifts and the back arches; hands rest on the thighs near the knees.

name: Knees up and wide, leaning back
description: Sitting on the floor, knees bent up and spread wide, feet flat and apart. The torso leans back, supported by both hands on the floor behind the hips.

name: Knees up and wide, hands on knees
description: Sitting on the floor with knees bent up and spread wide, feet flat. The torso is upright and both hands rest on top of the knees.

name: Legs in a wide V, leaning back
description: Sitting with both legs straight and spread wide in a V. The torso leans back on both hands placed behind the hips, chest lifted, head tilted back.

name: Seated, one leg held straight up
description: Sitting with the left leg folded on the floor. The right leg is stretched straight up toward the ceiling, held at the ankle with the right hand; the left hand props behind.

name: Knees wide, reclined on elbows
description: Lying back on both elbows with the upper body raised. Knees are bent up and spread wide, feet flat on the floor; the head tilts back.

name: Legs out, leaning on an elbow
description: Sitting with both legs stretched out and slightly bent, the body reclining to the side on one elbow and forearm, the other hand resting on the thigh.

name: Holding the knees apart
description: Sitting with both knees bent up; each hand holds the inside of a knee, pulling the knees apart. Feet are on the floor, torso upright.

name: Hugging one knee, back arched
description: Sitting with the right knee drawn up and hugged with both arms, the left leg bent along the floor. The back arches and the head tips back.

name: Side sit, hands behind the head
description: Sitting with both legs folded to one side. Both hands are raised behind the head, elbows wide, the torso upright and slightly twisted.

name: Kneeling sit, hands on the floor in front
description: Sitting between the heels (knees together, feet out to the sides). Both arms reach straight down in front with palms on the floor between the knees, shoulders drawn in.

name: One knee out wide
description: Sitting upright with the right knee bent up and opened out to the side, the left leg folded under. The right hand rests on the raised knee, the left hand on the floor beside.

name: Knees hugged, slightly apart
description: Sitting with both knees pulled up to the chest, slightly parted, feet together on the floor. Both arms wrap around the shins, hands crossed in front.

name: Kneeling upright, arched, hands behind the head
description: Kneeling upright on both knees with the thighs vertical. The back arches, both hands are clasped behind the head with elbows wide.

name: On all fours, back arched
description: On hands and knees, arms straight under the shoulders, knees under the hips. The back dips into an arch and the head lifts to look forward.

name: Kneeling wide, sitting low
description: Kneeling with the knees spread wide and the hips lowered between them, torso upright. Hands rest on the thighs.

name: One knee down, hand on the thigh
description: Kneeling on the left knee with the right foot planted forward, knee up. The right hand rests on the right thigh, the left hand on the hip.

name: Kneeling wide, hands down in front
description: Kneeling with the knees spread wide and the hips lowered, leaning forward. Both arms are straight down in front with the hands on the floor.

name: Kneeling wide and low, hands in the hair
description: Kneeling with knees wide and the hips lowered toward the heels, torso upright. Both hands are raised behind the head, elbows wide.

name: Camel: arched back, hands on the heels
description: Kneeling upright, the body bending back in a deep arch until both hands hold the heels. The hips push forward and the head drops back.

name: Kneeling, hips twisted, one arm up
description: Kneeling upright with the hips swung to one side. The right hand is on the hip; the left arm is raised with the hand behind the head.

name: Chest to the floor, hips high
description: Knees on the floor under the hips, the chest lowered to the floor and both arms stretched forward along it. The hips stay high; seen from the side.

name: All fours, one leg raised back
description: On hands and knees; one leg extends straight back and up high behind, toes pointed. The arms stay straight, head looks forward.

name: Sitting back between wide knees, hands down
description: Sitting back between the knees, which are spread apart. Both arms reach straight down in front with the palms on the floor between the knees, the body leaning forward.

name: Kneeling, hips pushed forward
description: Kneeling upright with the thighs angled forward and the hips pushed ahead of the knees. Both arms hang at the sides; the back arches slightly.

name: Kneeling, side bend over one hand
description: Kneeling upright, then bending to the right with the right hand on the floor beside the knee. The left arm arcs over the head toward the right.

name: Kneeling back bend, one hand to the heel
description: Kneeling and arching back with one hand reaching down to the heel. The other arm is raised with the hand behind the head; the head drops back.

name: On the side, one knee bent
description: Lying on the left side, propped on the left forearm with the head resting on the hand. The top (right) knee is bent and drawn forward; the waist curves.

name: On the front, chin in hands, feet up
description: Lying on the stomach propped on both elbows, chin resting in the hands. Both knees are bent so the feet point up behind.

name: On the front, chest lifted (cobra)
description: Lying on the stomach, legs straight behind. Both arms push the upper body up off the floor into a backbend; the head looks forward and up.

name: Back raised, one leg up
description: Lying on the back with the shoulders and arms on the floor. The hips lift off the floor; one knee is bent with the foot down and the other leg is raised straight to the ceiling.

name: On the back, knees together to one side
description: Lying on the back with both arms stretched overhead. The knees are bent together and dropped over to one side, twisting the hips.

name: On the front on the elbows, legs apart
description: Lying on the stomach, propped on both forearms, the upper body raised. The legs are straight behind and slightly apart.

name: On the side, head propped, knee up
description: Lying on the side, head propped on one hand. The top knee is bent and lifted high; the free hand rests on the knee.

name: On the front, hips raised
description: Knees on the floor and drawn in under the hips, the chest and cheek resting low on the floor with the arms folded under the head. The hips are raised high.

name: On the back, legs up in a V
description: Lying on the back with both legs raised straight up and spread in a wide V. The arms rest on the floor; the head is slightly lifted.

name: On the back, arched, arms overhead
description: Lying on the back with both arms stretched over the head. The chest lifts in an arch; one knee is bent with the foot on the floor.

name: On the front, looking back, knee out
description: Lying on the stomach propped on the elbows, looking back over the shoulder. One knee bends out to the side; the other leg is straight.

name: On the side, top leg raised
description: Lying on the side, propped on the lower elbow. The top leg is raised straight up toward the ceiling and held at the ankle with the top hand.

name: On the back, knees up, one arm overhead
description: Lying on the back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. One arm is stretched up over the head, the other rests on the stomach.

name: On the front, frog legs
description: Lying on the stomach with arms folded under the chin. Both knees are bent out to the sides with the soles of the feet together behind.

name: On the back, knees to the chest
description: Lying on the back with both knees pulled up to the chest, the legs together. Both hands hold the shins.

name: On the front, chin in hand, one leg up
description: Lying on the stomach propped on the elbows, chin resting in one hand. One knee is bent with the foot pointing up; the other leg lies straight.

name: On the back, one knee dropped out
description: Lying on the back with the arms over the head. One knee is bent up; the other knee drops out to the side with the sole of the foot against the other leg.

name: Reclining on the elbows, one knee up
description: Half-reclining on both forearms, upper body raised. One knee is bent up with the foot on the floor, the other leg straight.

name: Bridge on the shoulders, knees apart
description: Lying on the back with the shoulders and arms on the floor, the hips lifted high in a bridge. The knees are bent and spread apart, feet flat.

name: Legs over the head, holding the thighs
description: Rolled back onto the shoulders with the hips lifted, the legs swung up over the body. Both hands hold the backs of the thighs; seen from the side.

name: Plough: legs over the head
description: Rolled back onto the shoulders with the hips high, the straight legs reaching over the head so the toes touch the floor behind it; arms on the floor.

name: Rolled back, knees beside the head
description: Rolled back onto the shoulders, the hips over the head, the knees bent down to rest on the floor beside the ears; arms on the floor.

name: Deep squat, knees wide
description: Squatting deep on flat feet with the knees spread wide. The forearms rest on the knees, hands hanging loose; the torso upright.

name: Squat on tiptoes, hands on the floor
description: Squatting on the balls of the feet with the knees wide apart. Both arms reach down between the knees with the fingertips on the floor.

name: Standing split, folded forward
description: Standing on one leg, folding forward until both hands touch the floor, the other leg raised straight up behind toward the ceiling.

name: Front split, arms up, back arched
description: In a front split on the floor, one leg straight forward, the other straight back. The torso is upright and arched back, both arms raised overhead.

name: Shoulder stand, legs in a V
description: Balanced on the shoulders with the body vertical, hands supporting the back. Both legs are straight up and spread in a V.

name: Kneeling back bend, hands on the floor
description: Kneeling and bending back, the hips sinking toward the heels, until both hands rest on the floor behind the feet; the head drops back.

name: Deep squat, hands behind the head
description: Squatting deep with the knees spread wide and heels down. Both hands are clasped behind the head with the elbows wide.

name: One-leg bridge
description: Shoulders and arms on the floor, the hips lifted in a bridge on one bent leg; the other leg is raised straight up toward the ceiling.

name: Reverse table-top
description: Facing up, supported on hands (behind, fingers forward) and flat feet, knees bent at 90°. The hips push up level with the knees; the head looks forward.
